title: 注意力 O(n²) 复杂度与 MQA/GQA KV 节省量化
expected_output:
MHA KV 字节: 2147483648  MB: 2048.0
MQA(1 KV头) 字节: 67108864  MB: 64.0
GQA(8 KV头) 字节: 536870912  MB: 512.0
MQA 节省倍数: 32.0
GQA 节省倍数: 4.0
注意力 FLOPs 量级(操作计数): 17592186044416
code:
layers = 32; n_heads = 32; head_dim = 128; seq = 4096; dt = 2
def kv_bytes(kv_heads):
    return layers * kv_heads * head_dim * 2 * dt * seq
full = kv_bytes(n_heads)
mqa = kv_bytes(1)
gqa = kv_bytes(n_heads // 4)
print("MHA KV 字节:", full, " MB:", round(full / 1024 / 1024, 1))
print("MQA(1 KV头) 字节:", mqa, " MB:", round(mqa / 1024 / 1024, 1))
print("GQA(8 KV头) 字节:", gqa, " MB:", round(gqa / 1024 / 1024, 1))
print("MQA 节省倍数:", round(full / mqa, 1))
print("GQA 节省倍数:", round(full / gqa, 1))
n = 8192
flops_attn = 2 * n * n * head_dim * n_heads * layers
print("注意力 FLOPs 量级(操作计数):", flops_attn)
